items.title: Microsoft's October Security Update Fixes 1,400+ Vulnerabilities, One Exploited in the Wild
items.blurb: Microsoft's latest monthly security update addresses 1415 vulnerabilities across multiple products. One vulnerability affecting Windows Shell has been exploited in the wild, while 85 are classified as critical.

items.title: Cloudflare Opens Quicksilver to Customers as Workers KV Instant, Inside a 1 MB Envelope
items.blurb: Cloudflare has put Quicksilver, the internal key-value store behind nearly every request it serves, into private beta as a Workers KV mode. Reads resolve in 1.62 ms at p99 against 287 ms for classic KV.

items.title: Amazon ECS now supports GPU sharing with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service (MPS)
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now supports GPU sharing with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service (MPS), enabling you to run multiple Amazon ECS tasks concurrently on a single NVIDIA GPU.

items.title: SageMaker MLflow Apps now support MLflow 3.16
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker AI MLflow Apps now support MLflow 3.16, bringing a redesigned tracing experience and faster experiment tracking to your generative AI and machine learning workflows.

items.title: Amazon Aurora serverless now supports up to 384 ACUs
items.blurb: Amazon Aurora serverless now supports database capacity of up to 384 Aurora Capacity Units (ACUs) for Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition, a 50% increase from the previous maximum of 256 ACUs.

items.title: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now supports changing durability on existing clusters
items.blurb: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now lets you enable or disable durability on your existing node-based clusters without creating a new cluster. Previously, you couldn't change the durability configuration of an existing cluster in place.

items.title: Amazon Corretto October 2026 Patch Updates
items.blurb: On October 26, 2026 Amazon announced a patch update for the following Amazon Corretto Long-Term Support (LTS) and Feature Release (FR) versions of OpenJDK.

items.title: Amazon Neptune now supports online index rebuild to reclaim storage
items.blurb: Amazon Neptune Database now supports online index rebuild, a new capability that helps database administrators and application teams defragment Neptune indexes and reclaim unused storage space without taking their database offline.
